chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, when He intends to afflict the people of the earth with punishment, says: Were it not for those who love one another for My Majesty, maintain My mosques, and seek forgiveness in the pre-dawn hours—were it not for them, I would surely send down My punishment.

key_terms.بِعَذَابٍ: with punishment; divine chastisement sent upon people
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted; a formula magnifying Allah’s transcendence and majesty
key_terms.عَذَابِي: My punishment; Allah’s punishment withheld due to the presence of the righteous
key_terms.يَتَحَابُّونَ بِجَلَالِي: they love one another for My Majesty; mutual love grounded in devotion to Allah
key_terms.يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ: they seek forgiveness in the pre-dawn hours; they perform istighfar at the blessed time before dawn
key_terms.يَعْمُرُونَ مَسَاجِدِي: they maintain My mosques; they frequent, uphold, and enliven the mosques through worship

ai.seo_question: What deeds prevent divine punishment from descending upon people?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that certain righteous servants are a cause for the deferral of divine punishment from the people of the earth. It highlights three qualities in particular: loving one another for Allah’s sake, maintaining the mosques, and seeking forgiveness at the pre-dawn hours.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1369 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:

"Indeed, when Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, intends to afflict the people of the earth with punishment, He says, 'Were it not for those who love one another for My Majesty, who populate My mosques, and who seek forgiveness during the pre-dawn hours, I would surely send down My punishment.'" '"
